archive_layout.app: Upstream runtime sources and standalone modules
archive_layout.vendor: Reviewed pure Python packages and their distribution metadata
archive_layout.bundle-manifest.json: Manifest with file hashes, distribution provenance and capabilities

info.format_version: 1: Base85 ZIP; 2: Base85 XZ ZIP; 3: single Latin-1 source literal; 4: bounded Latin-1 source chunks; 5: ZIP_STORED application with a small __main__.py and payload.bin
info.sha256: SHA-256 of decoded ZIP bytes; cache identity for all envelopes
info.compression: Versions 2-5: lzma; versions 3-5 also allow zip for directly encoded per-file-deflated ZIP
info.payload_sha256: Versions 2-5: original compressed or directly encoded payload SHA-256
info.payload_encoding: Versions 3/4: latin1 or latin1-chunks; version5: zip-member

bootstrap_contract.payload: Versions1/2 use Base85 source literals. Versions3/4 use PEP263 Latin-1 framed literals, bounded to256KiB decoded bytes per chunk in format4. Version5 stores exact compressed payload bytes in the ZIP_STORED member payload.bin and removes the outer import path before stdlib imports. Compressed SHA-256 is checked before bounded decoding to an owned temporary file; decoded ZIP size/hash, exact EOF, members, manifest and complete cache are checked before dispatch.

context.artifact: Absolute single-file artifact path as str
context.root: Absolute extracted cache root as str

bootstrap_contract.cache_flag: --cache-dir PATH is consumed by bootstrap before command dispatch
bootstrap_contract.internal_module: --internal-module MODULE ARGS is dispatched through runpy in the initialized runtime
bootstrap_contract.upstream_startup: initialize_bundle binds the verified source root before dispatch; hermes_bootstrap skips PM and source-update activation only for that bound tree

decompression_limits.extra_streams: Rejected; exactly one complete XZ stream is required

bootstrap_contract.windows_cache_security: The bootstrap embeds the stdlib-only windows_acl.py boundary before extraction; directories are created atomically with a protected inheritable DACL, and cache entries must have this user as owner and grants limited to this user, SYSTEM and Administrators.

source_transform.default: none: the AST stage preserves selected application/resource and vendored bytes; separately reviewed vendoring source patches remain applied with original sources/RECORD and exact before/after hashes preserved in provenance
source_transform.optional_ast: Only app Python sources; exact location-free AST, recursive compiled-code fingerprint and idempotence must match; retain original bytes on failure or growth
source_transform.preserved: Names, literals, docstrings, annotations, asserts and comment/license text
source_transform.not_equivalent_in_ast_mode: Source text and comment locations, tracebacks, tracing/coverage positions, inspect/source reads, and return values derived from frame/source introspection
source_transform.reproducibility: AST mode requires the same Python implementation and exact recorded three-part version for building and running; mismatched runtimes are rejected before cache creation. Default source-preserving mode has no additional toolchain gate.
source_transform.proof: Full deterministic per-file proofs are written to OUTPUT.py.minify.json; the artifact embeds its SHA-256, toolchain, aggregate counts and byte totals. The sidecar is not needed to run the artifact.
